why: Pilot, 2026-11-04: the deck spends cards faster than it replaces them. A place to experiment with steady card draw, wheel tutors and mana-to-cards sinks while the list stays high bracket three; he will play it before anything is merged.

commits.message: The contender: draw engine plus the combo package, the pilot's word 2026-11-04
the mana tightened across all three colours

summary.title: The contender: steady draw, Tithe loops, more wheels and tightened mana
summary.blurb: Adds steady draw, loops through Smothering Tithe and more wheels, then retunes the lands and a rock so all three colours are castable on curve from what the deck draws.

staged.why: Pilot's approved package 2026-11-04: steady draw; a slow six-drop he has seen discarded becomes five cards, ten doubled, with Shabraz out.
Pilot's approved package 2026-11-04: a mana-to-cards sink; with Shabraz one mana per card, stopping at will.
Pilot, 2026-11-04: version X. Cheap draw on turn three instead of a four-drop, so the early turns have a play.
Pilot, 2026-11-04: version X. Early mana for the commanders; Robe is protection the goldfish cannot price, so this cut is his judgment.
Pilot, 2026-11-04: cheap mana test. Rocks moved every speed dimension; Boros Signet the most mana.
Pilot, 2026-11-04: cheap mana test. A rock that also says no maximum hand size, so the hand limit stops costing cards.
Pilot, 2026-11-04: a one-sided wheel with flashback in place of a card-down loot.
Pilot, 2026-11-04: an instant one-sided wheel that nets a card; Stoneforge lost Embercleave and Robe.
Pilot, 2026-11-04: no maximum hand size, for the same land count.
